notes.title: Redesigned Demo Map
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Google Feedback Form In Main Menu.
[*] Added New Demo Map With Completely Different Design.
[*] Made Safe Instructions clearer.
[*] Heavily Changed Ghost Girl Animations.
[*] Fixed Various Bugs and Improved Overall Gameplay.
[/list]
Make Sure to play try the new house and submit the form with your feedback in main menu.

notes.title: Biggest Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Localization[/h1]
[h3]	Fully translated in-game text and menus to the following languages:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 		Chinese (Simplified).
[*] 		Chinese (Traditional).
[*] 		English.
[*] 		Arabic.
[*] 		French.
[*] 		German.
[*] 		Japanese.
[*] 		Korean.
[*] 		Polish.
[*] 		Portuguese.
[*] 		Russian.
[*] 		Spanish.
[*] 		Thai.
[*] 		Turkish.
[*] 		Ukrainian.
[/list]

[h1]Big Game Changes[/h1]
[h3]	Complete UI Overhaul, Steam Achievments, Redesigned puzzles with minimal text and more![/h3]
[list]
[*] 		 Completely changed the UI, including the Main Menu, Settings, Lobby, and in-game interactions.
[*] 		Added the microphone sensitivity threshold and screen brightness adjustment menus when launching the game for the first time.
[*] 	Added Steam Achievements to the Demo.
[*] 	Removed Tutorials and the Single-Player Mode.
[*] 	Removed most instruction text from puzzles.
[*] 	Added a meter that shows if the player is making noise, whether walking, talking, or interacting.
[*] 	Enabled players to choose which house to start in.
[*] 	Made the Ghost hide the item you are holding when you get caught.
[*] 	Made the player character place a red footprint at the last location heard by the Ghost.
[*] 	Added loading screens with game tips.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 	Added hints next to puzzles.
[*] 	Added a TV with game tips.
[*] 	Added extra Drawers in the environment.
[*] 	Made highlighting of other players animated.
[*] 	Added a strikethrough on puzzle names when they are solved.
[*] 	Made the timer and Ghost anger status always visible.
[*] 	Changed the anger icon to be more intuitive, clearly indicating the current AI state.
[*] 	Added sounds and animations for locks and doors when they fail to open.
[*] 	Shortened patrol bumps and made her wait only +1 second instead of +3 before moving again.
[*] 	Reduced the wait time in corners before moving.
[*] 	Increased the noise range for players' actions. ( The Ghost can now hear you farther).
[*] 	Added a smooth crouch animation.
[*] 	Replaced "Alpha Beta Bernard Franck" from the frames and safe puzzle with symbols.
[*] 	The host can now kick a player and ban them from the lobby.
[*] 	You can now hold movement keys to choose or rotate dials or buttons when interacting with puzzles.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 	Fixed an issue where the Ghost Girl intro sequence turned off your mic, requiring you to press V to reactivate it.
[*] 	Fixed the ladder animation not working.
[*] 	Fixed a bug where making noise in certain areas could cause the Ghost Girl to get stuck.
[*] 	Fixed a bug where dropping from the ladder opening then crouching didn't make noise.
[/list]
